import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (box plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by sensor type
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax2.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], alpha=0.6, label=sensor, s=30)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Camera count by brand (top 10)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10)
sns.barplot(x=brand_counts.values, y=brand_counts.index, ax=ax3, palette='viridis')
ax3.set_title('Top 10 Camera Brands by Count', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Models', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11)

# 4. 4K video capability by year
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_by_year = df.groupby('model_year')['has_video_4k'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
video_by_year['percentage'] = (video_by_year['sum'] / video_by_year['count']) * 100
ax4.plot(video_by_year.index, video_by_year['percentage'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
ax4.fill_between(video_by_year.index, video_by_year['percentage'], alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('% with 4K Video', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('4K Video Adoption Over Time', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight vs Price by body type
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(body_types))
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax5.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], alpha=0.6, label=body, s=30, color=colors[i])
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(fontsize=9, loc='upper right')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. ISO capability distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
iso_bins = [0, 6400, 12800, 25600, 51200, 102400, 204800]
df['iso_range'] = pd.cut(df['max_iso'], bins=iso_bins, labels=['<6.4k', '6.4k-12.8k', '12.8k-25.6k', '25.6k-51.2k', '51.2k-102.4k', '>102.4k'])
iso_counts = df['iso_range'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors_iso = plt.cm.YlOrRd(np.linspace(0.3, 0.9, len(iso_counts)))
ax6.pie(iso_counts.values, labels=iso_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_iso)
ax6.set_title('Max ISO Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
